description:
Some things are easier once you have a starting point.

How to Adult is a pocket guide to everyday life, with 56 guides across Home, Food, Money, Work, Wellbeing, People and Everyday. Find a guide for the thing in front of you, then work through it one step at a time.

Wash a load of laundry. Cook a simple meal. Make a first budget. Understand your 401k. Check your car. Settle into a new room. Make plans with a friend.

Each guide breaks the task into clear steps, with practical supplies, cautions and links to sources where needed. Guides that depend on United States rules say so.

- Search the included library without an internet connection.
- Check off steps as you go.
- Save useful guides for another day.
- Pick a date, time and sound preference for a local reminder.
- Share a guide through your device's share menu.
- Get published guide updates from the live library, with an offline copy kept on your device.

Use the native app on iPhone, iPad or Mac. Your saved guides, progress and reminders stay on the device where you create them.

No account, ads, subscription or in-app purchases.
notes:
No account or demo credentials are required. All 56 starter guides are bundled and available offline.

Open a topic or search the library. Open a guide, check a step and save the guide; progress persists locally. Use the bell to choose a future date, time and sound preference for a local reminder. Notification permission is requested when saving a reminder. Declining permission does not block reading or saving guides.

Sources appear below each sourced guide. United States-specific guides identify their scope. Sharing uses the system share menu.

The public editorial catalog updates over HTTPS, retaining the last valid downloaded library for offline use. Personal bookmarks, checked steps, reminders and local search queries are not uploaded. The same English library is available on iPhone, iPad and Mac; personal progress does not sync between devices.

There are no ads, purchases, subscriptions or remote push notifications.
